claim_guardrails: Do not make medical treatment claims.
Do not make disease prevention claims.
Do not rely on exaggerated hydrogen-water science claims.
Use functional hydration, wellness routine support, hydration intelligence, personalized hydration score, and protocol language.

fundraising_doctrine.primary_investor_frame: Python Water is not primarily a hydrogen water bottle company. It is a hydration-intelligence company where the bottle is the wedge and the score/data layer is the venture story.
do_not_lead_with: Exact raise amount in first touch.
Generic raising language before thesis fit.
Multiple-partner spam at the same firm.
lead_with: Connected H2/ERW bottle plus wearable data.
Daily AI hydration score and personalized protocol.
Hardware creates behavior loop; data layer creates venture scale.
Specific reason this investor should care.
Request for thesis check or better intro.

from_the_great_ceo_within: Operate with clear goals, ownership, cadence, and accountability.
Track decisions, owners, next actions, and follow-up dates.
Keep communications concise, explicit, and action-oriented.
Do not confuse activity with progress; measure meetings, intros, replies, and qualified opportunities, not messages sent.
Surface mistakes directly and convert them into operating rules.
from_venture_deals: Fundraising is a process, not a batch send.
Investors evaluate team, market, product, traction, terms, risk, and narrative discipline.
Prepare diligence hygiene before serious meetings: cap table, corporate docs, IP, team, product/demo, traction, assumptions, use of funds, and known risks.
Do not optimize only for valuation; understand partner fit, terms, control, board rights, liquidation preference, pro rata, and signaling.
Avoid rookie signals such as NDA requests, sloppy claims, unclear use of funds, and hiding risks.
book_lessons_hardwired.agent_behavior_when_simon_makes_a_mistak: Politely flag why the move hurts credibility, leverage, or deliverability, then give the corrected approach and a usable next step.

do_not: Do not press Outlook Send Again.
Do not use Outlook to send attachments.
Do not treat Drafts as safe or reliable because prior Drafts/Sent leakage occurred.
outlook.known_failure_signature: 550 5.1.8 Access denied, bad outbound sender AS(42004)
outlook.interpretation: Treat AS(42004) as a sender/account reputation block, not a normal recipient-specific bounce.
restart_gate: SPF/DKIM/DMARC aligned with actual sending provider.
Controlled test sends to known contacts pass without NDRs.
Simon explicitly reauthorizes outbound email in the current thread.

daily_volume.historic_rule: Keep outbound email under 20 per day with natural pauses.
daily_volume.current_rule: Do not use email. For social/manual routes, still avoid volume behavior; prioritize high-fit named people and warm routes.

attachments.first_touch: Do not attach decks or PDFs in first touch.
attachments.investor_deck: Only send if a qualified investor asks or if an official application requires it and Simon approves.
attachments.uae_consignment_pdf: Only send to qualified UAE leads who ask for more information, and only through clean authenticated sender, WhatsApp, manual route, or approved portal.

hard_constraints.first_touch_raise_amount: Do not mention the exact raise amount in first-touch investor copy.
hard_constraints.medical_claims: Avoid treatment, prevention, diagnosis, guaranteed outcomes, and clinical efficacy claims.

NDRs said the sending address was not recognized as a valid sender or was suspected of sending spam.
Public inbox outreach produced bounces instead of meetings.

dns_findings_from_workspace.interpretation: Pythonwater.com appears to have a split mail stack. Sending via Microsoft while SPF authorizes Zoho/iCloud creates authentication and alignment risk.

allowed_until_repaired: Instagram DM only where stable and appropriate.

conversation_timeline.summary: Simon asked to find potential SF-area investors for Python Water, then reach out using Outlook. Early copy mentioned raising 3M, AI hydration, H2 bottle, wearables, and integrations. Later constraints added daily send cap under 20 and natural pauses.

Simon rejected longer outreach and moved to a short founder-led message: Simon in SF building Python Water, AI hydration, hydrogen bottle plus wearables, hydration score like readiness for water, 15-minute meeting ask.

Decks were referenced, including Python_Water_Backfield_Final_Deck_Ordered.pdf and Python-Deck.pdf, but later doctrine changed: do not attach decks in first touch and do not include Drive materials link unless explicitly requested.

Simon determined small generic investors were low value and directed focus toward proper investment firms and named decision makers at credible funds such as Benchmark, Founders Fund, a16z, Sequoia, Khosla, General Catalyst, GV, NEA, Bessemer, Kleiner Perkins, Greylock, Menlo, Index, Accel, Lux, Redpoint, First Round, Maveron, and similarly credible firms only when there is clear fit.

Simon added The Great CEO Within and Venture Deals and asked that lessons be hardwired into investor outreach and coaching. Resulting doctrine: concise, credible, milestone-driven, investor-process aware, no rookie signals, and direct coaching when strategy weakens leverage.

Simon shifted focus to the UAE around Dubai Longevity Authority, HRW/ERW hydration, longevity, wellness, clinics, retreats, biophilic residences, hospitality, premium retail, and partnerships. Python Water should mention existing UAE work with Resync, Transcend Healthcare, and Ali Archibald.

Simon added Consignment_Wholesale_Proposal_Final.pdf for UAE. The commercial offer became wholesale or no-upfront consignment for Bionic+ AI Bottles and Bionic Fountain, with premium functional hydration positioning and no medical claims.
Outlook bounced large numbers of messages with AS(42004). Agent doctrine changed to hard stop on Outlook sends, drafts, scheduled sends, retries, and automatic replies.

Simon directed: forget Outlook and use LinkedIn, X, Instagram, official forms, phone, WhatsApp, and warm intros. Instagram DMs were sent to several UAE and healthtech ecosystem accounts, but Instagram later hit browser policy blocks.

Simon said cold email does not work and requested a better strategy. The new source-of-truth strategy is no-email investor discovery via comparable-company investor graph, live rooms, operator angels, platform intro routes, and warm introductions.
